findings.summary: Removing a cart item removed the focused control without moving focus to a useful element.
findings.fix: Move focus to the next or previous item control, or to the cart heading when the list becomes empty.
findings.evidence: The Remove button is unmounted with its cart row.

findings.summary: Order type and payment errors were not programmatically associated with their radio controls.
findings.fix: Give each group error an ID and reference it from the radio controls with aria-describedby.
findings.evidence: The group error paragraphs initially had no descriptions linked to their controls.

passed: Cart controls, checkout form fields, radio buttons, and navigation use native interactive elements.
The skip link and route changes provide predictable focus behavior.
Invalid customer fields receive focus; cart deletion now focuses the next item or cart heading.
notes: The automated Playwright accessibility scanner could not run because Playwright is not installed; interaction and responsive behavior were tested in the integrated browser.
Findings were recorded before their indicated fixes; the final implementation was verified afterward.
